en: A colorized postcard view of a riverside town with a large historic hilltop complex overlooking the water. In the foreground a long, white paddle steamer labeled "BASTEI" travels along a wide river. On the opposite bank are small houses with red roofs and a quay, while above them rises a fortified palace-like structure and other large buildings surrounded by trees. The sky is lightly clouded with a gradient from yellow near the horizon to blue above. Printed captions at the top read "Pirna a. d. Elbe." on the left and "Schloss Sonnenstein." on the right.
